dedupe_keys.name: bhutan power system operator public system reports

description: BPSO provides a public archive of daily, quarterly and annual system reports. Each listing shows a file name and upload date with view and download controls. The provider is Bhutan Power System Operator. Coverage: Coverage is Bhutan’s system-operator reporting. Recent daily PDF names identify 09:00 and 19:00 observation references; the archive includes entries through 27 September 2026. Access: The public report list and current publication dates were read. No report files or extracted data were obtained. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: Upload dates differ from the observation dates embedded in some file names. Variables, completeness and full historical coverage were not established from the index alone. For simulation it provides a route to dated operational evidence and system snapshots. Related resources: BPC data books describe annual utility information; BPSO reports are a distinct operational series.
